name: comp-33
blurb: Email input with label inset at the top.
description: An email input where the label sits inside the container at the top, above the input field. Built with a div wrapper and native input element.
use_when: Forms needing a compact label that doesn't overlap or animate, always visible.
avoid_when: You need floating labels or animated label behavior.
a11y: Label linked to input via htmlFor. Has focus-within border and ring. Supports aria-invalid for error states.
